verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover a dedicated API versioning page that guarantees preserved input and output parameters per Messages API version, plus pinned versioned model IDs. A standing model-deprecations page sets advance-notice retirement floors and provides migration guides. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the deprecation policy in practice, and explicit documentation of deprecation timelines for API versions (as opposed to models).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: For any given version with the Messages API, Anthropic preserves: Existing input parameters, Existing output parameters
pinned versioned IDs vs. moving forms
advance-notice deprecation policy with migration guides
